gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi keeps its round letters wide open inside, with curves that never rush to close. Anek Gurmukhi sits under Redux's widely spaced, enlarged lowercase and would carry a full page of text without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall and squared-off, its stroke ends held well back from the stems. Redux sits above it with a gentle taper and wide spacing, and a long page of text would move along briskly without feeling cramped or heavy.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin raises its lowercase almost to capital height and holds its curves open, while Redux above has lightly engraved contrast. A long page would read steadily.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-malayalam: Contemporary and clean, with barely any drop from lowercase to capitals. Redux spreads wide and enters its curves with a visible flourish, while Anek Malayalam keeps its curve tips apart in a plain sans that stays out of the way.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil fills its lowercase with big round bowls and leaves its c and s looking half unwrapped. And a long page of it would feel modern and easy, set beneath Redux's gently tapered, glassy strokes.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu moves along on wide, tall bowls that stay unlatched, so its text feels friendly and clean. And Redux adds a subtle swing of thick and thin that makes the pairing's greatest strength its easy, open rhythm.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anuphan: Anuphan rounds its lowercase into big bowls and leaves clear gaps in every curve. Anuphan would hold up well if Redux were made small, though that wide, flowing display face really wants room to stretch.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-arimo: Wide-set letters with a visible entrance into every curve give Redux its stamp. And Arimo, a sans-serif with a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounds, would keep a long page moving without strain.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-armata: Redux spreads its letters wide and keeps real weight even at the thinnest point of each curve, a trait Armata doesn't copy. Armata's tall lowercase and open gaps keep the page steady beneath it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-athiti: Friendly and cut like sign vinyl, Athiti keeps one line width and leaves a see-through gap in every s. Redux handles the heavier verticals of a tilted nib; Athiti handles plain, steady text.
